findings.highlight: your third appearance in Studio Troy
findings.evidenceJa: 三丁目のスタジオトロイ
findings.explanation: The source locates Studio Troy in the third chome. The translation turns that address element into Setsuna's third appearance at the venue.
findings.japanese:
「三丁目のスタジオトロイで。
来週末にライブなんでしょ？」
findings.todokanai: "I'm talking about your third appearance in Studio Troy. You're having a live concert next weekend, aren't you?"

findings.highlight: her true calling is in expressing her feelings
findings.evidenceJa: 基本は感性で生きてる
findings.explanation: The speaker says Setsuna fundamentally lives by intuition or sensibility despite seeming intellectual. The translation changes this way of moving through life into a vocational calling to express feelings.
findings.japanese:
「あれだよね、小木曽ちゃんって
峰城出ててインテリっぽいけど、
基本は感性で生きてるよね」
findings.todokanai: "I know what this is. Ogiso-chan's looked like an intellectual ever since she left Houjou, but her true calling is in expressing her feelings."

findings.highlight: I don't have feelings for them
findings.evidenceJa: あなたと違って割り切れるからね
findings.explanation: Youko says she can compartmentalize or keep the relationship cleanly separated, unlike Kazusa. The translation instead denies that she has feelings at all, changing the distinction she draws between feeling and conduct.
findings.japanese: 「あなたと違って割り切れるからね」
findings.todokanai: "Unlike you, I don't have feelings for them."

findings.highlight: Shandy Editing of The Orient Magazine
findings.evidenceJa: 東邦出版、シャンディ編集部
findings.explanation: Itakura identifies Touhou Publishing and the Shandy editorial department. The translation invents a magazine titled 'The Orient' and treats Shandy Editing as a unit within it.
findings.japanese:
「あの～、すいません。
東邦出版、シャンディ編集部の板倉と申しますが」
findings.todokanai: "Um, excuse me? I'm Itakura from Shandy Editing of The Orient Magazine."

findings.highlight: We're going to have you on our front page
findings.evidenceJa: 来月号の表紙は冬馬さんで行きますから
findings.explanation: Itakura promises Kazusa the cover of next month's issue. A magazine cover is not a newspaper-style front page, and the issue timing is also omitted.
findings.japanese:
「あ、それと後日正式に依頼に上がりますが、
写真撮影の方もよろしくお願いしますね。
来月号の表紙は冬馬さんで行きますから！」
findings.todokanai: "Oh and also, we'll send a request at a later date, but we look forward to doing a photoshoot with you too. We're going to have you on our front page!"

findings.highlight: Tell me everything
findings.evidenceJa: 何でも聞いてください
findings.explanation: The reporter invites Youko to ask her anything. The translation reverses the flow of information and tells Youko to disclose everything instead.
findings.japanese:
「はい？　なんでしょうか？
本当、もうざっくばらんで行きましょう！
何でも聞いてください」
findings.todokanai: "Yes? What is it? Let's not keep anything hidden! Tell me everything."

findings.highlight: countless places nearby
findings.evidenceJa: この近く、何軒か案内できますよ
findings.explanation: The reporter says she can show them a few nearby restaurants. 'Countless' inflates a small, concrete number into an unlimited range.
findings.japanese:
「あ、それともお食事がまだでしたら、
何か食べられるお店の方がいいかしら。
この近く、何軒か案内できますよ？」
findings.todokanai: "Ah! Or if you haven't eaten yet, we could go to a place that serves food. I can guide you to countless places nearby."

findings.highlight: doing its best to contradict that
findings.evidenceJa: その予報を一度に再現しようと
findings.explanation: The weather seems to be trying to reproduce both sides of the forecast at once by producing rain and snow together. The translation says it is contradicting the forecast, reversing the image.
findings.japanese:
天気予報では、今夜は『雨、または雪』って言ってたけど、
実際の天気は、どうやらその予報を一度に再現しようと、
無理やり頑張っているみたいだった。
findings.todokanai: According to the weather forecast, it will either rain or snow tonight, but it seems like the weather itself is doing its best to contradict that.

findings.highlight: Since I have a history with you
findings.evidenceJa: 昔のお前を知ってる俺には、もう…っ
findings.explanation: Haruki breaks off after saying that, as someone who knew the old Kazusa, he can no longer... The translation supplies a completed causal statement about merely having a history together.
findings.japanese:
「近づかないんじゃなかったのかよ…
昔のお前を知ってる俺には、もう…っ」
findings.todokanai: "Weren't you never going to come near me ever again…? Since I have a history with you…!?"

findings.highlight: I'm only helping her out a little
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっと世間話をするだけだ
findings.explanation: Haruki tells himself he is only making a little small talk. The translation recasts that rationalization as helping Kazusa, giving him an altruistic purpose absent from the source.
findings.japanese:
俺は、ただ事務的に話してるだけだ。
ちょっと世間話をするだけだ。
findings.todokanai: I'm simply answering her in a professional way. I'm only helping her out a little.

findings.highlight: It's reasonable to say I'd die if I fell asleep
findings.evidenceJa: だから『眠ったら死ぬぞ』とか言われても大丈夫だ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says the stock warning is harmless or inapplicable because she cannot fall asleep. The translation instead endorses the warning as reasonable.
findings.japanese:
「寒い、寒いよ、春希…
けど眠れない。
だから『眠ったら死ぬぞ』とか言われても大丈夫だ」
findings.todokanai: "I'm cold, I'm cold, Haruki… but I can't fall asleep. It's reasonable to say I'd die if I fell asleep."

findings.highlight: glues herself to my back
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の後ろについて、ゆっくりと
findings.explanation: Kazusa slowly follows behind Haruki; the following line then begins her attempt to climb onto him. The translation makes her adhere to his back one beat too early and collapses the staged action.
findings.japanese: そして、俺の後ろについて、ゆっくりと…
findings.todokanai: And then she slowly glues herself to my back…

findings.highlight: that night in Strasbourg
findings.evidenceJa: ストラスブールのイブの夜
findings.explanation: The explicit callback is to Christmas Eve night in Strasbourg. Omitting 'Eve' strips the temporal marker that identifies the remembered scene.
findings.japanese: …あの、ストラスブールのイブの夜みたいに。
findings.todokanai: …Just like that night in Strasbourg.

findings.highlight: I show Kazusa a thumbs up
findings.evidenceJa: 指で丸印を作り
findings.explanation: Haruki makes a circle or OK sign with his fingers. The translation substitutes a thumbs-up, and the same substitution recurs when Kazusa returns the signal.
findings.japanese:
指で丸印を作りかずさの方に示すと、
向こうは結構無感動で軽く頷いた。
findings.todokanai: I show Kazusa a thumbs up, but she only nods apathetically.

findings.highlight: I'll call you back myself. I think I'll do so tomorrow or the day after that
findings.evidenceJa: こちらから連絡しておきます。明日か明後日にでもそちらに伺うと思います
findings.explanation: Haruki says they will contact the other party and that Kazusa will probably visit tomorrow or the next day. The translation turns the projected visit into Haruki calling back himself.
findings.japanese:
「ああ、いや！　大丈夫！
こちらから連絡しておきます。
明日か明後日にでもそちらに伺うと思います」
findings.todokanai: "Ah, no! It's okay! I'll call you back myself. I think I'll do so tomorrow or the day after that."

findings.highlight: holds the warm bowl firmly in her hands
findings.evidenceJa: 熱いはずの土鍋をしっかり抱え込む
findings.explanation: Kazusa hugs the earthenware hot pot that ought still to be hot. The translation substitutes a merely warm bowl held in her hands, losing both the prop and the dangerous physical closeness.
findings.japanese:
文句を言いながら、
かずさが熱いはずの土鍋をしっかり抱え込む。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa holds the warm bowl firmly in her hands, complaining all the while.

findings.highlight: Being a celebrity is part of being an artist
findings.evidenceJa: 芸術家って言ったところで芸人の一種だろ
findings.explanation: Haruki argues that even an artist is one kind of entertainer and therefore needs an interested audience. The translation reverses the containment relation and substitutes 'celebrity' for entertainer.
findings.japanese:
「芸術家って言ったところで芸人の一種だろ。
自分に興味持ってくれる人がいなくちゃ、
話が始まらないんだぞ？」
findings.todokanai: "Being a celebrity is part of being an artist. You wouldn't be able to get anywhere if people didn't take an interest in you."

findings.highlight: Are you going after me now?
findings.evidenceJa: 今度は開き直りか
findings.explanation: Haruki accuses Youko of brazenly owning or doubling down on her position. The translation instead asks whether she is attacking him, changing the target and nature of his retort.
findings.japanese: 「今度は開き直りか？」
findings.todokanai: "Are you going after me now?"

findings.highlight: climb the ranks of a company like that
findings.evidenceJa: その社会の中で上の方には行ける
findings.explanation: Youko speaks about rising within whatever society, field, or community one enters. The translation narrows the principle to corporate promotion inside a company.
findings.japanese:
「その社会の中で上の方には行けるけど、
トップに上り詰めることはできそうにないな」
findings.todokanai: "You might be able to climb the ranks of a company like that, but you'll never reach the top."

findings.highlight: You have changed less in these five years than me
findings.evidenceJa: 五年前から少しも変わってない
findings.explanation: Haruki says Kazusa has not changed at all since five years ago. The translation invents a comparison with himself and allows that she may have changed somewhat.
findings.japanese:
「なぁ、かずさ…
お前こそ、五年前から少しも変わってないじゃないか」
findings.todokanai: "Hey, Kazusa… You have changed less in these five years than me, don't you think?"

findings.highlight: Kazusa would have gotten sick of me
findings.evidenceJa: ずっとそうしていたら、いつかかずさは俺のこと呆れて
findings.explanation: Haruki imagines a future consequence if he keeps acting this way: someday Kazusa will tire of him. The translation turns it into an unreal past counterfactual.
findings.japanese:
ずっとそうしていたら、
いつかかずさは俺のこと呆れて、苦笑して、
何もかも馬鹿馬鹿しくなったって言い出して。
findings.todokanai: If I kept this up, Kazusa would have gotten sick of me, given me a bitter laugh and exclaimed that everything has become ridiculous.

findings.highlight: I woke her up when I saw you were coming
findings.evidenceJa: 来るとわかってたら起こしたんですけど
findings.explanation: Haruki says he would have woken Kazusa if he had known Youko was coming, implying he did not. The translation asserts that he did wake her when he learned of the visit.
findings.japanese:
「すいません。
来るとわかってたら起こしたんですけど」
findings.todokanai: "I'm sorry. I woke her up when I saw you were coming but…"

findings.highlight: "And you dare say you don't belong in Japanーthat this is outside of your territory? Your mother is utterly embarrassed."
findings.evidenceJa:
「何が日本には居場所がない、よ。
ここだけ治外法権？
親の面目丸つぶれ」
findings.explanation: Youko jokes that Kazusa's apartment is an enclave of extraterritorial jurisdiction inside Japan; 'outside of your territory' mistranslates the mock-legal metaphor.
findings.japanese:
「何が日本には居場所がない、よ。
ここだけ治外法権？
親の面目丸つぶれ」
findings.todokanai: "And you dare say you don't belong in Japanーthat this is outside of your territory? Your mother is utterly embarrassed."

findings.highlight: five years ago and also half a year ago
findings.evidenceJa: 五年と半年前
findings.explanation: The source gives one point in time, five and a half years ago. The translation splits it into two separate times, five years ago and half a year ago.
findings.japanese:
俺がこれを始めた五年と半年前、
とある不良っぽい同級生に腕前の差を思い知らされた
屈辱的なエピソードがあったけど…
findings.todokanai: When I started playing the guitar five years ago and also half a year ago, I became painfully aware of the skill difference between me and a certain delinquent classmate, and it was a rather humiliating experience…

findings.highlight: there is actually another feeling existing alongside
findings.evidenceJa: 方向性の違う二つの気持ちが混在してる
findings.explanation: Haruki says two feelings pointing in different directions coexist within his self-interest, and the following lines enumerate them. The translation reduces the pair to one additional feeling.
findings.japanese:
けれど、そんな自己都合の中にも、
本当は、さらに方向性の違う二つの気持ちが混在してる。
findings.todokanai: But inside that self-interest, there is actually another feeling existing alongside, coming from a different direction.

findings.highlight: talking with sincerity
findings.evidenceJa: 感性で話してるように見える
findings.explanation: Youko appears to speak by intuition or sensibility while accurately probing Haruki's weak spots. 'Sincerity' assigns her a moral quality rather than the instinctive mode of thought under discussion.
findings.japanese:
…感性で話してるように見えるのに、
的確にこっちの穴を突いてくるんだもんなぁ。
findings.todokanai: …She makes it look like she's talking with sincerity, but she never misses an opportunity to put me in a bind.

findings.highlight: "That's why I want you to show everyone. Show them the expressions she only shows you."
findings.evidenceJa:
「だから、みんなに見せてあげて欲しいのよ。
この子が、あなたにだけ見せる素顔を」
findings.explanation: Youko wants Haruki to show the public Kazusa's unguarded, true self—the self she reveals only to him; 'the expressions she only shows you' narrows that motive to facial expressions.
findings.japanese:
「だから、みんなに見せてあげて欲しいのよ。
この子が、あなたにだけ見せる素顔を」
findings.todokanai: "That's why I want you to show everyone. Show them the expressions she only shows you."

findings.highlight: at the end of the week
findings.evidenceJa: 週明けにもう一度編集部に連絡する
findings.explanation: Youko will contact the editorial department again at the beginning of the coming week. The translation moves the call to the end of the week.
findings.japanese:
「とにかく、考えておいて。
週明けにもう一度編集部に連絡する」
findings.todokanai: "At any rate, think about it. I'll contact the editing department once again at the end of the week."

findings.highlight: whom I brought home on Friday
findings.evidenceJa: 金曜の夜に部屋に来たかずさ
findings.explanation: The source only says Kazusa came to Haruki's room Friday night. The translation asserts that Haruki brought her home, inventing his agency in her arrival.
findings.japanese:
金曜の夜に部屋に来たかずさが再び目覚めたのは、
結局、日曜の朝だった…
findings.todokanai: Kazusa, whom I brought home on Friday, didn't wake up until Sunday morning…

findings.highlight: To accept my exclusive coverage of Kazusa
findings.evidenceJa: かずさの独占取材権を勝ち取れ
findings.explanation: Youko told Haruki to win the right to exclusive coverage of Kazusa. The translation makes him accept coverage rather than obtain the reporting rights.
findings.japanese:
かずさの独占取材権を勝ち取れって。
来日期間中、ずっとあいつに張りつけって。
findings.todokanai: To accept my exclusive coverage of Kazusa. To be on her tail during her stay in Japan.

findings.highlight: didn't materialize
findings.evidenceJa: 約束違反は結局通じなかった
findings.explanation: Haruki's needy breach of his promise—placing the call so Setsuna could decide for him—ultimately did not connect or get through. The translation says only that his desire failed to materialize, obscuring the actual failed call.
findings.japanese:
そんな、雪菜に決断を委ねようとした、
俺の甘えた約束違反は結局通じなかった。
findings.todokanai: In the end, my childish desire to push the decision onto Setsuna didn't materialize.

findings.highlight: It's an overbearing result
findings.evidenceJa: しごく当然で、そして重い結果
findings.explanation: The result is utterly natural or only to be expected, yet heavy: Haruki must bear responsibility himself. 'Overbearing' instead presents that demand as oppressive or presumptuous.
findings.japanese:
自分で責任を負えという、
しごく当然で、そして重い結果が。
findings.todokanai: It's an overbearing result telling me to bear the responsibility by myself.

findings.highlight: All my family around the same age have gathered
findings.evidenceJa: 同期の家族とか集まってて
findings.explanation: Hamada is at a barbecue with peers from his cohort and their families. The translation turns them into members of his own family who happen to be around the same age.
findings.japanese:
「そうなのか？
こっちは今、バーベキューの最中でな。
同期の家族とか集まってて」
findings.todokanai: "Is that so? I'm actually in the middle of a barbecue right now. All my family around the same age have gathered."
